required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 30 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is execution still on branch `agent/terminal-status-propagation-seal-restart-rework-v3` and Draft PR #5 targeting `main`?
Is the v8 Decision `APPROVED`, `engineering_branch`, and bound to active `reverse-agent-iteration@v2`?
Is the committed v8 Decision the sole task authority, with `task_packet.json` background-only?
Is the v8 Decision commit an ancestor of every v8 implementation, evidence, final publication commit, and PR merge-test commit?
Are v4-v7 archived and sealed artifacts unchanged?
Does a new v8 execution segment exist with v8 IDs, v8 Decision digest, v8 command-plan digest, v8 startup time, and no reused v4 restart identity?
Was v8 Decision content locked before the final v8 command-plan was generated and locked?
Does the final command-plan bind the exact v8 IDs, branch, Decision digest, Decision commit, and plan digest?
Does the command-plan distinguish local commands from CI-only commands without weakening either command authority?

Does every executable command in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `state-gate.yml`, and `decision-preflight.yml` have exact command-plan authorization or an explicitly accepted non-project setup classification?
Are CI-only commands exempt only from local transcript requirements, while still requiring exact remote workflow evidence?
Does `local-ci-parity` fail closed for an unauthorized workflow command and pass for an authorized CI-only command?
Is `PENDING_EXTERNAL` available only when the Decision explicitly requires external attestation and forbids post-attestation commits?
Does `PENDING_EXTERNAL` mean local prerequisites passed but no claim is made about remote conclusions?
Do report-summary and Required Audit reject false remote `PASS` claims when remote observations are absent, stale, from another Decision, or for another head SHA?
Can final-check, run-closeout, close-round, context sync, state manifest, archive, and final seal converge on truthful local readiness without claiming external acceptance?
Is `PENDING_EXTERNAL` never treated as final `ACCEPTED` inside the repository?
Does the external audit remain the only authority that converts exact-head remote results into one of the four allowed audit conclusions?
Is the current context packet generated after the final live local gate and bound to its digest?
Do report-summary, execution-log, pytest metadata, final-check, context, state manifest, round manifest, closeout, and seal agree on v8 IDs and the pre-attestation recommendation?
Is every required local command recorded with command, kind, exit code, stdout/stderr provenance, and observed chronology?
Is `final-evidence-seal` recorded as an authorized executed command and not only as an ungrounded terminal event?
Do focused tests cover report truth, pending-external semantics, command-plan CI surfaces, stale remote evidence, head-SHA binding, execution segment identity, and final-seal logging?
Are all changed files inside the v8 allowlist?
Were merge, rebase, force-push, direct-main push, branch creation, new PR creation, and `git add -A` avoided?
Is the final v8 validation commit the PR head with no later branch commit?
Did CI complete successfully for exact final v8 head?
Did State Gate complete successfully for exact final v8 head?
Did Decision Preflight complete successfully for exact final v8 head?
Do exact-head remote results support the external audit conclusion without any post-final repository mutation?
